newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randfontein says job cuts completed.
newsitem.headline: Randfontein says job cuts completed.

text.p: Randfontein Estates Gold Mining Co Ltd, a unit of JCI Ltd, said on Tuesday it had finished retrenchments at the struggling mine as part of its completed restructuring programme.
"The programme necessitated the retrenchment of 3,162 employees and a reduction in production of underground ore of 340,000 tons to 270,000 tons per month.
"The retrenchment process with the various unions has been successfully concluded," it said in a statement.
The mine earlier posted dismal June quarter results, its pre-capex net loss ballooning to 16.88 million from 2.86 million in the March quarter.
JCI and the National Union of Mineworkers last month reached an agreement over the job cuts and related severance packages, averting the risk of a strike.
The company said it had completed the major phase of the restructuring, announced in May, and expected improved grades and reduced costs at the mine.
